title: Overlay Network
definition: A distributed network driver that creates a virtual network on top of multiple physical Docker hosts, allowing containers on entirely different physical servers to communicate securely as if they were on the same local switch.
simpleExplanation: A magic tunnel. Container A is on a server in New York. Container B is on a server in London. The Overlay network builds an encrypted tunnel over the public internet, allowing them to talk to each other securely over a private local IP address.
realWorldExample: Used heavily in Docker Swarm and Kubernetes architectures. A 100-server cluster uses an Overlay network so the load balancer on Server 1 can route traffic to an API container randomly running on Server 87.

basic: Which network driver allows containers on two completely different physical computers to communicate?
intermediate: What underlying technology secures the traffic passing through a Docker Overlay network over the public internet?

answers.question: Secured how?
answers.answer: Docker natively uses IPSec (Internet Protocol Security) to encrypt all data traffic moving between the different host machines in the overlay.
